title: Einstein's relativity rules chemical bonds in heavy elements, new research shows
ai_summary:
• Research shows Einstein's relativity plays a crucial role in chemical bond formation in heavy elements
• Study applies the laws of relativity to predict chemical bond strength and stability
• Breakthrough may have significant implications for materials science and materials engineering research

title: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
ai_summary:
• QuadRF, a cutting-edge RF scanner, can detect drones from 10 km away.
• Device can also see through walls to identify and map internal WiFi networks.
• This tech could find its way into security, surveillance, and smart building applications.
student_angle: Learn RF sensing for potential use in cybersecurity and smart home IoT development.

title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
ai_summary:
• Apple sues OpenAI over alleged theft of trade secrets by ex-employees from Apple.
• The lawsuit claims the theft compromised sensitive information about Apple's research and development.
• Ex-employees worked on AI-related projects during their time at Apple before joining OpenAI.
student_angle: Consider avoiding working with AI-focused projects if possible, as they may involve sensitive research and data.

title: An update on residential proxies and the scraper situation
ai_summary:

• Companies scramble to prevent bot and scraper attacks on their platforms.
student_angle: Learn about IP rotation and residential proxy management to stay ahead in cybersecurity.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produces proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture [pdf]
ai_summary:
• GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, a variant of the language model GPT-5, has proven the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture.
• Researchers used GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra to find a proof for the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture in graph theory.
• The proof has been published in a research paper available for download as a PDF.

title: SpaceX wants to launch 100k more Starlink satellites for 100x the bandwidth
ai_summary:
• SpaceX to launch 100,000 additional Starlink satellites for enhanced global internet connectivity and bandwidth.
• Increased satellite capacity aims to provide 100 times more bandwidth to users worldwide.
• Expanded Starlink fleet expected to enhance internet connectivity in remote areas.
student_angle: This expansion in space technology may create internship opportunities in areas like satellite engineering and telecommunications.

title: The tech of 'Terminator 2' – an oral history (2017)
ai_summary:
• The 1991 film "Terminator 2: Judgment Day" was a showcase for early CGI and tech advancements.
• Visual Effects supervisors used Amiga computers and custom software to create on-screen effects.
• The film's tech legacy continues to influence the film and gaming industries today.
student_angle: This oral history offers insight into early computer graphics and software development - worth learning as a historical context.

title: Good Tools Are Invisible
ai_summary:

• Custom-built tools can be more effective than generic software, offering tailored solutions and better integration.

title: Late Bronze Age Collapse
ai_summary:

title: New York City to ban deceptive subscription practices
ai_summary:

title: US cybersecurity agency CISA had to build its incident playbook during the incident, agency reveals
ai_summary:
• CISA's incident playbook development indicates a reactive rather than proactive approach to cybersecurity.
• Public exposure of sensitive data, including passwords, via a contractor's GitHub repository caused the incident.
• The cybersecurity agency's internal investigation revealed the need for a more detailed incident response plan.

title: Phia accused of ‘cookie stuffing,’ taking affiliate credit on purchases it didn’t earn
ai_summary:
• Phia, a shopping startup founded by Bill Gates’ daughter, accused of “cookie stuffing” in sales tracking.
• Practice allowed Phia to receive commissions and credit for sales it did not actually generate, reports Bloomberg.
• Investigation casts doubt on transparency and trustworthiness of affiliate marketing in e-commerce.

title: Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash
ai_summary:
• Instagram's new AI feature, "Collaborations," allowed users to reference public content from other accounts.
• The feature has been removed due to backlash from users and Instagram's blog post statement.
• The company aims to provide more relevant creative tools for users while taking feedback into consideration.

title: Bluesky’s interim CEO, Toni Schneider, drops the ‘interim’
ai_summary:

title: China is catching up to Elon Musk’s reusable rockets
ai_summary:
• China's state-owned space company, China National Space Administration, successfully recovered its first orbital rocket booster.
• The recovery marks a significant milestone in China's efforts to develop reusable rockets, potentially lowering the cost of access to space.
• This achievement puts China in competition with Elon Musk's reusable rockets and may lead to faster private spaceflight development.
• The technology has the potential to be applied in various areas, including satellite deployment, space tourism, and commercial launches.
student_angle: None. However, this development highlights the increasing investment in space technology and may create opportunities for internships and research collaborations in aerospace engineering.

title: Disney+ is considering a free streaming tier, report says
